{{Top|leg}}
An '''omniron''' was a personal hygiene device that lathered the skin with needle streams of biodetergents, sprayed [[Water/Legends|water]], and palpated the skin and flesh with sonics. It would then dry and heat the skin, rubbing emollients onto it with autoapplicators. Each activity would occur in a specific, timed sequence and was monitored by a [[Computer/Legends|computer]].
